PRESIDENT'S ORDER 7 OF 1979
PRESIDENT'S ORDER 7 OF 1979
HIGH COURT JUDGES (LEAVE,
PENSION AND PRIVILEGES) (AMENDMENT) ORDER, 1979
[Gazette of Pakistan,
Extraordinary, Part I, 13th March 1979]
No. F. 17(2)/79-Pub.-The following Order made by the
President is hereby published for general information:-
Whereas it is expedient further to amend the High
Court Judges (Leave, Pension and Privileges) Order, 1970 (P. O. No. 9 of 1970),
for the purpose hereinafter appearing ;
Now, therefore, in pursuance of the Proclamation of
the fifth day of July 1977, read with the Laws (Continuance in Force) Order,
1977 (C. M. L. A. Order No. 1 of 1977), and in exercise of all powers enabling
him in that behalf, the President is pleased to make the following Order :-
1. Short title and
commencement.-(1) This
Order may be called the High Court Judges (Leave, Pension and Privileges)
(Amendment) Order, 1979.
(2) It shall come into force at once.
2. Amendment of paragraph
21, P. O. No. 9 of 1970.-In
the High Court Judges (Leave, Pension and Privileges) Order, 1970 (P. O. No. 9
of 1970), in paragraph 21, for the proviso the following shall be substituted,
namely :-
"Provided that a Judge who had opted to be
governed by the provisions applicable to him before such commencement ; and
(a) has retired, or retires, as such after the
fourteenth day of August 1973, may, within six months from the commencement of
the High Court Judges (Leave, Pension and Privileges) (Amendment) Order, 1978
or, as the case may be, from the day on which he retires, opt to be governed by
the provisions of this Part ; or
(b) has been, or is, appointed Judge of the Supreme
Court after the fourteenth day of August 1973, may, within six months of the
commencement of the High Court Judges (Leave. Pension and Privileges)
(Amendment) Order, 1979, or, as the case may be, from the day on which he is so
appointed, opt to be governed by the provisions of this Part."
